description: This file defines a PHP trait named ModuleScreenHelperTrait within the OrangeHRM Core namespace. The trait provides a protected method getCurrentModuleAndScreen(), which retrieves the current module and screen information via the ModuleScreenHelper class. It serves as a utility component to be included in other classes.

methods.name: getCurrentModuleAndScreen
methods.description: Returns the current module and screen as a ModuleScreen object by invoking the static helper method.
